What's going on? How serious?
The future of Eibon!
Emergency! Come!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多！紧急呼叫鉴定师！

See you at Eibon!
Okay.

Content.LocalizedString: Are there many of them? They didn't hurt you, did they?
I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 总之你别着急，我这就过来。

I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 总之你别着急，我这就过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I'm on my way over.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，成立了爱好者协会！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo started a fan club!
cool.jpg

Content.SourceString: 本人申请加入塔吉多爱好者协会。
Content.LocalizedString: I hereby apply to join the Taygedo Fan Club.

Content.SourceString: 恭喜~喜欢塔吉多的人肯定会越来越多的！
Content.LocalizedString: Congratulations! I'm sure more and more people will fall in love with Taygedo!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师是协会会长，塔吉多内定！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser is the club president, and Taygedo is the honorary member!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，好伙伴！头号粉丝！协会会长！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, great buddy! Number one fan! Club president!

Content.SourceString: 原来我被内定了，真是荣幸……
Content.LocalizedString: So I've been hand-picked… what an honor…
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多在白鲸书店看书，想请教鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo is reading at Moby-Dick Bookstore, wants to ask Appraiser for help…

Content.SourceString: 可是可以……但如果是读书遇到的问题，或许找埃德嘉更合适？
Content.LocalizedString: I suppose I could help… but if it's about something you read, maybe Edgar would be a better choice?
Wait for me at Moby-Dick Bookstore.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，想向其他人保密，只有鉴定师知道！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo wants to keep it secret from others, only Appraiser should know!
excited.jpg
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，参透了涨粉秘籍！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo figured out the secret to gaining followers!

Content.SourceString: 成为大明星的秘密计划，想和鉴定师商量！
Content.LocalizedString: Secret plan to become a big star, wants to discuss it with Appraiser!
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 好呀好呀，我到哪里找你？
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, sure! Where should I find you?

Content.SourceString: 要叫上伊波恩的大家吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Should we invite everyone from Eibon?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多在仓库，为计划做准备！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo is in the warehouse, preparing for the plan!

Content.SourceString: 是秘密计划！只能被鉴定师知道！
Content.LocalizedString: It's a secret plan! Only Appraiser can know!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师悄悄来，对大家保密！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser come quietly, keep it secret from everyone!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多在仓库，等鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo is in the warehouse, waiting for Appraiser!
cool.jpg
Alright, I'll be there in a moment.
excited.jpg
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: <Blue>#治安所公益短篇特辑，与巡哨鼠鼠一起维护正义！JUSTICE！#</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>#Security Office's Community Short Stories: Join Officer Whisker in upholding justice! JUSTICE!#</>

Content.SourceString: 呗果热门！异象警官小短片！好酷！
Content.LocalizedString: Bagel's trending! Anomaly officer mini-episode! So cool!

Content.SourceString: 维护治安与疏导交通，我们很荣幸能为市民服务！
Content.LocalizedString: Maintaining public safety and directing traffic! We're honored to serve our citizens!

Content.SourceString: 红黄绿三鼠组，好酷好酷！
Content.LocalizedString: The red, yellow, and green mouse trio is so cool!

Content.SourceString: 警车嘟嘟！警车还会飞！嘟嘟嘟！
Content.LocalizedString: Police car goes wee-woo! Police car can even fly! Wee-woo-woo!

Content.SourceString: 唔，原来鼠鼠们会乘坐这辆体积很小的迷你警车出勤。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, so the little officers ride in that tiny mini police car when they're on duty.

Content.SourceString: 不仅速度惊人，追击嫌疑犯的时候还会飞起来？！
Content.LocalizedString: It's not just incredibly fast, but it can even fly when chasing suspects?!

Content.SourceString: 可爱的同时，性能也绝佳……
Content.LocalizedString: Not only is it adorable, but the performance is also exceptional…
Toy police car! So many cool features!
Taygedo! Wants to uphold justice too! JUSTICE!

Content.SourceString: 你其实是看上了那辆会飞的警车吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You're actually just interested in that flying police car, aren't you?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多警官！要求查看你的驾照！
Content.LocalizedString: Officer Taygedo! Show me your driver's license!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多警官！发现你已超速！
Content.LocalizedString: Officer Taygedo! You've been caught speeding!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多警官！知道你破坏了很多公物！
Content.LocalizedString: Officer Taygedo! I know you've damaged lots of public property!

Content.SourceString: 我在深刻反省了！塔吉多长官！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Officer Taygedo!

Content.SourceString: 醒一醒塔吉多，以你的体型，你是坐不进那辆玩具警车的。
Content.LocalizedString: Wake up, Taygedo. With your size, there's no way you'd fit into that police car.
JUSTICE!
Tayge!!!

Content.SourceString: 维护正义！干得好！鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Upholding justice! Well done, Appraiser!
Tayge!!!

Content.SourceString: 唔……原来塔吉多有时候也会戏瘾大发……
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… so Taygedo sometimes gets really into role-playing too…

Content.SourceString: 这绝对是承认的意思吧？
Content.LocalizedString: So you agree?
Tayge!!!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，狂追第三季《心猎铁骑》！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo! Wildly obsessed with "Kokoro Rider" Season 3!

Content.SourceString: 异象猎人！装甲变身！飞檐走壁！
Content.LocalizedString: Anomaly hunter! Transform! Wall running!

Content.SourceString: 炫酷多多！好评多多！塔可小姐喜欢看！塔吉多也在看！
Content.LocalizedString: So cool! So awesome! Tako likes to watch it! Taygedo watches it too!
So many things to talk about with Tako!
blushing.jpg
shy.jpg
Sounds like things are going well for you.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，也要寻找主题色！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo wants to find his theme color too!
What theme color?
Pink! The color of main characters!
The exclusive color for big shots!
cool.jpg

Content.SourceString: 的确，颜色能够影响人的第一印象。
Content.LocalizedString: You're right, colors can definitely influence people's first impressions.

Content.SourceString: 譬如红色会给人热情开朗的印象，紫色则是优雅神秘。
Content.LocalizedString: Like how red gives an impression of passion and liveliness, while purple conveys elegance and mystery.
Tayge?
Taygedo… Taygedo wants to stay mysterious.

Content.SourceString: 但塔吉多……不想让别人看出来，塔吉多很神秘。
Content.LocalizedString: But Taygedo… Taygedo doesn't want others to see through him. Taygedo is very mysterious!
Then just pick a color you like.
thinking.jpg
starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔可小姐，喜欢粉色！塔吉多！也最喜欢粉色！
Content.LocalizedString: Tako loves pink! Taygedo loves pink the most too!
Just as I expected…

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，听到「碎雪」冰淇淋车广告声！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo heard the Blizzi ice cream cart jingle!
Taygedo, ready to dash!
pumpedup.jpg
Bring me back a strawberry one.
Bring me back a chocolate one.
noproblem.jpg
thumbsup.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多也最喜欢巧克力！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo loves chocolate the most too!
CHAAAAARGE!!!
thumbsup.jpg
So many people at the ice cream cart!
Taygedo, waiting patiently!

Content.SourceString: 今日招牌，华夫饼蛋筒！鉴定师，要不要？
Content.LocalizedString: Today's special: waffle cone! Want one, Appraiser?
I'll take one.
One in a cone, one in a cup.
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多不打算试试看华夫饼蛋筒吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Aren't you going to try the waffle cone too, Taygedo?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，喜欢蛋筒，不喜欢蛋筒屑……
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo loves ice cream cones, but hates the crumbs they leave…
It'll get all over me and be all sticky!

Content.SourceString: 掉到背上，塔吉多，够不着！摘不掉！
Content.LocalizedString: If it falls on my back, Taygedo can't reach it! Can't get it off!

Content.SourceString: 什么情况会把蛋筒屑吃到背上？
Content.LocalizedString: How would you even get cone crumbs on your back?
Taygedo's Unique Troubles!

Content.SourceString: 做个小发明专门打扫蛋筒屑怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: What about making a little invention specifically for cleaning up cone crumbs?
lightbulb.jpg
Appraiser, you're full of great ideas!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，要买两个蛋筒！测试冰淇淋蛋筒屑清扫机！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo gonna buy two cones! Time to test the Ice Cream Cone Crumb Cleaner!

Content.SourceString: 这是塔吉多，鉴定师的好朋友！
Content.LocalizedString: This is Taygedo, the Appraiser's good friend!
Hello, little otter.
Taygedo sure adds friends quickly.
Good friends, lots of chat!
Taygedo, professional Bagel surfer!
cool.jpg
Taygedo's Dinner Investigation!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师的口味，大方告诉塔吉多！
Content.LocalizedString: Tell Taygedo all about the Appraiser's taste in food!
Mr. Adler will show us what he's got!
Delicious food? No problem at all!
I need to think this through first…
What does Taygedo like to eat the most?

Content.SourceString: 海胆贝壳，塔吉多统统吃掉！
Content.LocalizedString: Sea urchins and shells, Taygedo will eat them all up!

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，我的话最喜欢……
Content.LocalizedString: I see. As for me, I like…
I'm a sea urchin enthusiast too.
I'm a shell enthusiast too.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师！也是海鲜鉴赏家！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser! A seafood connoisseur as well!
admiring.jpg
thumbsup.jpg
praising.jpg
affirmative.jpg
Taygedo, huge discovery!

Content.LocalizedString: Bagel's selfie stickers are trending hot!

Content.SourceString: 贴纸多多，选择多多，亮闪闪多多！
Content.LocalizedString: So many stickers, so many choices, so many sparkly ones!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多喜欢亮闪闪！塔吉多要很多很多赞！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo loves shiny things! Taygedo wants lots and lots of likes!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Let's all give it a like.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多的大头贴我也来点赞。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll give Taygedo's selfie stickers a like too.

Content.SourceString: 我来号召大家一起给塔吉多点赞。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll rally everyone to give Taygedo some likes.
Taygedo, ready to snap!
I'm looking forward to Taygedo's stunning photos.
petrified.jpg
crying.jpg
angry.jpg
Stickers! Bad!

Content.LocalizedString: The frame is too small! Taygedo's whole face won't fit!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多！胳膊伸到最长！只有塔吉多半张脸！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo! Arm stretched all the way out! Only half of Taygedo's face showing!
In other words…
In other words…

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多的头太大了，镜头里装不下。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo's head is too big to fit in the Camera frame.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多的手太短了，导致距离不够。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo's arms are too short, so he can't get enough distance.
depressed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 买一根自拍杆？或者我和你一起拍怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: How about buying a selfie stick? Or maybe I could take the photo with you?

Content.SourceString: 让我来调整塔吉多的脸与镜头的距离。
Content.LocalizedString: Let me adjust the distance between Taygedo's face and the Camera.
admiring.jpg
starstruck.jpg
tailwagging.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多鉴定师，多多拍照！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo and Appraiser, take lots of photos!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师喜欢的贴纸，多多贴上！
Content.LocalizedString: Put lots of stickers that Appraiser likes!
Bearded chef! Bad! Super bad!

Content.SourceString: 人坏心坏！塔吉多，看不起！
Content.LocalizedString: Bad person, bad heart! Taygedo has no respect for you!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多私房钱，再也不攒给美味炼金术！
Content.LocalizedString: No more saving secret money for Delichemy! Taygedo quit!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多原来也对凯尼斯大厨的厨艺感兴趣吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So Taygedo is interested in Chef Kenneth's cooking skills too?

Content.SourceString: 美味炼金术餐厅，白贝壳星级！
Content.LocalizedString: Delichemy restaurant, La Palourde Blanche starred restaurant!

Content.SourceString: 呗果好评多多！据说海鲜美味多多！
Content.LocalizedString: Bagel has lots of good reviews! They say the seafood is super delicious!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多没尝过，但胡子大厨心坏！菜肯定也难吃！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo never tried it, but that bearded chef has bad heart! Food must taste bad too!

Content.SourceString: 理解塔吉多的心情，但厨艺并不一定与人品挂钩……
Content.LocalizedString: I understand how you feel, Taygedo, but someone's character doesn't necessarily reflect their cooking skills…

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒先生！可靠！温柔！做饭一流！
Content.LocalizedString: Mr. Adler! Reliable! Gentle! Top-notch cook!

Content.SourceString: 阿德勒大厨，完胜凯尼斯大厨！
Content.LocalizedString: Chef Adler beats Chef Kenneth by a mile!
supportive.jpg
K.O.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，支持阿德勒先生开餐厅！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo supports Mr. Adler opening a restaurant!

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩餐厅，完胜美味炼金术餐厅！
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon food destroys Delichemy food!

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩改成餐厅？那我们……给阿德勒先生打下手吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Turn Eibon into a restaurant? So we would… help Adler in the kitchen?

Content.SourceString: 是阿德勒大厨！塔吉多，多多支持！
Content.LocalizedString: It's Chef Adler! Taygedo, super support!
Taygedo can be the official taste tester!
affirmative.jpg
If we turned Eibon into a restaurant…

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多就不能偷吃了哦？
Content.LocalizedString: Then you wouldn't be able to sneak food anymore, right Taygedo?
petrified.jpg
whistling.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，不明白鉴定师在说什么！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo doesn't understand what Appraiser is saying!

Content.SourceString: 塔可小姐，分享今日运势测试！
Content.LocalizedString: Tako, sent Taygedo fortune test!
Taygedo never tested fortune, doesn't wanna check!

Content.SourceString: 但塔可小姐，很想知道！塔吉多，纠结！
Content.LocalizedString: But Tako really wants to know! Taygedo is so conflicted!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多是害怕测出不想要的结果吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you afraid you'll get a result you don't want, Taygedo?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多……是个务实的男人。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo… is a practical man.

Content.SourceString: 但塔吉多，不想辜负塔可小姐的期待。
Content.LocalizedString: But Taygedo doesn't want to let Tako down.
profound.jpg

Content.SourceString: 那就当找点乐子，玩玩看？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not just have some fun with it? Want to give it a try?

Content.SourceString: 无论测出怎样的结果，都不会影响到塔吉多的吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Whatever the fortune says, it's not going to actually affect you, right Taygedo?
thinking.jpg
Taygedo washed his hands!

Content.SourceString: <Blue>#正位太阳。嚯嚯嚯，测出这个结果的您财运极佳呢！点击界面跳转全部解析#</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>#Upright Sun. Ohohoho, with this result, your financial fortune is excellent! Click here to see the full analysis#</>
That's some pretty good luck.
starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多！零花钱也要多多！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo wants more allowance too!

Content.SourceString: <Blue>#正位战车。嚯嚯嚯，测出这个结果的您事业运极佳呢！点击界面跳转全部解析#</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>#Upright Chariot. Ohohoho, with this result, your career prospects are excellent! Click here to see the full analysis#</>

Content.SourceString: 看来接下来塔吉多的维修师工作也会很顺利。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo's work as a restorer will go smoothly from now on.
cool.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，伊波恩年度优秀员工！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo is Eibon's employee of the year!
proud.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多突然觉得，成熟的男人，要勇于尝试。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo realizes that a mature man must be brave enough to try new things.

Content.SourceString: 运势测算，可以多多尝试。
Content.LocalizedString: Fortune-telling is definitely worth trying more often!

Content.SourceString: 看来塔吉多很信赖占卜的结果。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo has become quite the believer in fortune tests.

Content.SourceString: <Blue>#逆位塔。哎呀哎呀，您的恋爱运听起来似乎有些不顺啊，点击界面跳转全部解析#</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>#Reversed Tower. Oh dear, oh dear, it seems your love fortune isn't looking too good. Click here to see the full analysis#</>
Ta-Tayge?!!!
terrified.jpg

Content.SourceString: 啊，塔吉多被戳到痛处了。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, that seems to have hit a sore spot for Taygedo.
No way! Absolutely not!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多……才不是迷信的男人！！！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo… is not a superstitious man!

Content.SourceString: 大明星鉴定师！大明星娜娜莉！
Content.LocalizedString: The super-duper famous Appraiser! The super-duper famous Nanally!
starstruck.jpg
Pretty cool, right?

Content.SourceString: 超炫超酷！塔吉多反复回放！！！忍不住跟着一起唱！！！
Content.LocalizedString: So awesome! So cool! Taygedo keeps watching it on repeat! Can't help but sing along!

Content.SourceString: 但是！大明星鉴定师！大明星娜娜莉！没义气！
Content.LocalizedString: But! The super-duper famous Appraiser! The super-duper famous Nanally! They're so disloyal!

Content.SourceString: 偷偷组乐队，不告诉塔吉多！
Content.LocalizedString: They formed a band in secret without telling Taygedo!
Sorry, Nanally asked me to keep it confidential…

Content.SourceString: 哼！娜娜莉没眼光，错过本音乐全才！
Content.LocalizedString: Hmph! Nanally has no eye for talent, missing out on this musical prodigy!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多现在决定要组建自己的乐队！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo has now decided to form his own band!
So Taygedo can play music too?
cool.jpg
There's so much that Taygedo can do!

Content.SourceString: 音乐全才塔吉多！下次弹尤克里里给鉴定师听！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo, musical prodigy extraordinaire! Next time I'll play the ukulele for the Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 顺便一说，尤克里里也是塔吉多自己做的！
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, the ukulele was handcrafted by Taygedo himself!
smug.jpg
Isn't that just a toy guitar?
It's a ukulele!

Content.SourceString: 下一届「月亮狗之夜」，就是塔吉多的异象乐队与猫头音的对决之时！
Content.LocalizedString: At the next Night of Moondog, Taygedo's anomaly band will have its ultimate showdown with The Whoots!
It's THE WHOOTS!!!!
What exactly is an anomaly band?

Content.SourceString: 「猫头音！！！！」的乐队鼓手，收下来自塔吉多的挑战书！
Content.LocalizedString: Drummer of THE WHOOTS!!!! You've just received an official challenge from Taygedo!

Content.SourceString: 就是异象组成的乐队！只有异象！
Content.LocalizedString: It's a band made up of anomalies! Nothing but anomalies!

Content.SourceString: 谁叫娜娜莉不带塔吉多玩！
Content.LocalizedString: It's all because Nanally wouldn't let Taygedo join in the fun!
grudge.jpg
Lead vocalist Taygedo, stunning the entire crowd!

Content.SourceString: 但大家听来，塔吉多只是在「塔吉塔吉」而已吧？
Content.LocalizedString: But to everyone else, isn't Taygedo just saying "Tayge Tayge" over and over?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉塔吉之歌，未来的摇滚金曲！
Content.LocalizedString: The TaygeTayge Song, the future rock classic!

Content.SourceString: 到时候别太崇拜塔吉多。
Content.LocalizedString: Try not to be too starstruck by Taygedo when the time comes.
cool.jpg
Tomato 100… so sour!
Sour! So sour! SUPER sour!
distorted.jpg
Taygedo, big disappointment!

Content.SourceString: 我还没有尝过，原来很酸吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't tried it yet. Is it really that sour?
Taygedo took a little taste.
Taygedo saw stars in the daytime!
dizzy.jpg
But Lacrimosa loves it!
Taygedo doesn't understand!
confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 每个人口味有差异是很正常的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone having different tastes is perfectly normal.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多……努力喜欢「番茄百分百」！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo… will try hard to like Tomato 100!

Content.SourceString: 罐装纸盒装可吸果冻袋装，统统拿下！
Content.LocalizedString: Canned, boxed, squeezable, or bagged… I'll take them all!

Content.SourceString: 不必强求自己改变自己的喜好。
Content.LocalizedString: You don't need to force yourself to change what you like.

Content.SourceString: 多多尝试后，或许就能接受番茄酱的酸度。
Content.LocalizedString: If you keep trying it, you might eventually get used to how sour the tomato jelly is.

Content.SourceString: 但塔吉多，很想理解安魂曲。
Content.LocalizedString: But Taygedo really wants to understand Lacrimosa.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多，会努力！但塔吉多，吃不完！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo will try hard! But Taygedo can't eat it all!
tearyeyed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多房间，好多好多番茄酱！吃不完！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo's room has sooooo much Tomato Jelly! Too much to eat!

Content.SourceString: 不妨联系安魂曲一起吃掉？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not ask Lacrimosa to help you eat it all?
How about throwing a tomato party?
Party! Taygedo loves that!
excited.jpg
